Upsert Contact By Phone Number.description: Creates a contact, or updates the existing one with the same URN, keeping registration data in sync.

Add Contact To Groups.description: Creates a new contact and places them in one or more contact groups.

Start Flow For Contacts.description: Starts a flow (e.g. an ANC reminder or survey) for specific contacts.

Start Flow By Phone Number.description: Starts a flow for phone numbers directly, passing extra data into the flow as params.

Start Flow For Group.description: Starts a flow for every contact in one or more groups.

Send SMS Broadcast.description: Sends a one-off message to phone numbers and/or existing contacts.

Send Broadcast To Group.description: Sends the same message to every contact in a group.

Upsert Many Contacts.description: Loops over a list of records and upserts one contact per item.
